Oath of Devotion.description: The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
3.tldr: Imbue your weapon with positive energy to add your Charisma bonus to attack rolls and shed bright light.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
3.tldr: Utter a holy prayer to turn fiends and undead, forcing them to flee from you.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.tldr: You and friendly creatures within range cannot be charmed while you are conscious.

15.name: Purity of Spirit
15.tldr: You are permanently protected by a constant protection from evil and good spell effect.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.tldr: Emitting an aura of sunlight, you blind enemies, gain advantage on saves against spells, and deal radiant damage.

Oath of the Ancients.description: The Oath of the Ancients binds paladins to submerge themselves in the light and green music of the wilderness.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
3.tldr: Invoke primeval forces to summon spectral vines that restrain a creature.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
3.tldr: Utter ancient words to turn fey and fiends away from your presence.

7.name: Aura of Warding
7.tldr: Ancient magic surrounds you, granting you and friendly creatures resistance to damage from spells.

15.name: Undying Sentinel
15.tldr: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can drop to 1 hit point instead once per long rest.

20.name: Elder Champion
20.tldr: Assume the form of an ancient force of nature to regenerate health, cast spells quickly, and impose disadvantage on enemies.

Oath of Vengeance.description: The Oath of Vengeance is a fierce, relentless commitment to punish those who have committed grievous sins.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
3.tldr: Frighten and freeze a target in place using your holy wrath and divine presence.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
3.tldr: Issue a supernatural vow of hostility against a creature to gain advantage on all attack rolls against it.

7.name: Relentless Avenger
7.tldr: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks immediately after hitting a creature with an opportunity attack.

15.name: Soul of Vengeance
15.tldr: Make a reaction attack against any creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity whenever it attacks.

20.name: Avenging Angel
20.tldr: Transform into an avenging angel with flying wings, emitting an aura of awe or dread that frightens enemies.
